debit.notes: Phone banking is 24/7; the contact page directs debit-card fraud reports and card blocking to the direct customer care line +91-22-69578555, with chargeable alternates 022-45393950 and 022-69578500. From abroad call +91-22-45393939 or +91-22-69578505 (ISD charges), or toll-free from KSA 8008501339, Qatar 800101098, USA 18339753958, UAE 8000181017. In the CSB Mobile+ app: Card Management & Control - Block your Card, plus Card On/Off, PIN and transaction limits. Lost-card email atm@csb.bank.in (ATM Switch Center 0484-6451631, 2368032); digital-payment-fraud FRM Cell 9072600128 / 0484-6690850. Bank pages' footer lists the 1930 national cybercrime helpline and NPCI DigiSaathi 1800-891-3333 / 14431. No SMS block format is published on official pages.

credit.notes: CSB credit cards are co-branded, with per-partner channels. CSB OneCard: helpline 1800-210-9111, email csbone@getonecard.app, or use the OneCard app (select 'Need Help?' from the Profile section). CSB Bank Edge card (Jupiter): chat via the top-right help icon in the Jupiter app, email edge-csb-support@jupiter.money, or call 080-45219280. Both co-brands escalate to the bank at customercare@csb.bank.in / 1800-266-9090. Unauthorized transactions can be reported on the bank's ODR complaint form, and the bank footer lists the 1930 national cybercrime helpline. No separate CSB credit-card block SMS or netbanking block path is published on official pages.
